zh: 白雲在積雪的山頂飄移
en: The bell of St. Mary's Church
Startling the ripples on the lake's surface
Also interrupting my train of thought
With the faint cool breeze of May
Slowly carried off toward the distance
Drifting near once more
White clouds drift over the snow-capped peak
Some cast their shadows upon the ripples
Just like this
Leaning along the lakeside embankment
Watching the ripples drift and turn
Some still shimmer and glitter
Scattered houses at the mountain's foot on the far shore
Gazing silently toward the lake
An old castle rising on a lone crag
Looking down over the lake as if nothing were amiss
A boat rocking beneath the shade of trees
Also leisurely docked along the shore
All around, such stillness
No one is willing to speak first
The ripples of Lake Bled
In the afternoon hour
A pattern sketched at will
It is so lovely to look at

points.zh: 布萊德湖 ( Lake Bled ) 位於斯洛文尼亞 (Slovenia ) 的北部， 阿爾卑斯山支脈內，距首都盧布爾雅那 ( Ljubljana ) 55公里。布萊德湖是冰川湖，由冰川融化後的冰水，以及阿爾卑山脈的積雪融化注入而成。湖水清澈寒冽，湛藍如綢緞，有“ 冰湖“ 之美譽。湖長 2.1公里，寬 1.4 公里，四周為積雪山峰和翠綠樹林所環抱，景緻秀麗雅靜 。湖畔古堡聳立，湖中島上白色教堂，時聞鐘響，自然和人文相映相成。
points.en: Lake Bled is located in the northern part of Slovenia, within a branch range of the Alps, 55 kilometers from the capital Ljubljana. Lake Bled is a glacial lake, formed from meltwater from glaciers together with snowmelt flowing down from the Alps. Its waters are clear and cold, blue as silk, earning it the reputation of the "Ice Lake." The lake is 2.1 kilometers long and 1.4 kilometers wide, surrounded on all sides by snow-capped peaks and lush green forests, presenting a scene of serene and elegant beauty. An ancient castle stands on the lakeshore, and a white church on the island in the lake occasionally sends the sound of bells ringing out — nature and human culture reflecting and completing each other.
